# Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(randomForest)
library(ranger)
library(caret)
library(performance)
```

# Load data
```{r}
source("_config.r")

# Load preprocessed plant model data (slopes + climate features + static env, one row per plot)
plant_data <- readRDS(PATH_MDL2_PLANT_DATA)
```

# Data preparation
## Check dimensions and remove incomplete rows
```{r}
dim(plant_data) # 1442 x 187
View(plant_data)
```

# Species change modelling
## Train test split
```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_idx          <- caret::createDataPartition(plant_data$total_change_pct, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
plant_change_train <- plant_data[ train_idx, ]
plant_change_test  <- plant_data[-train_idx, ]
```

## Hyperparameter tuning, mtry and min.node.size
```{r}
train_control <- caret::trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 10,
  savePredictions = "final",
  returnResamp    = "all"
)

set.seed(123)
rf_plant_change <- caret::train(
  total_change_pct ~ .,
  data        = plant_data,
  method      = "ranger",
  importance  = "none",
  num.trees   = 500,
  trControl   = train_control,
  tuneGrid    = expand.grid(
    mtry          = floor(ncol(plant_data) / 3),
    splitrule     = "variance",
    min.node.size = 5
  ),
  na.action   = na.omit,
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  verbose     = TRUE
)

rf_plant_change
rf_plant_change$results
rf_plant_change$resample

# Manual summary across all folds/repeats
resamp <- rf_plant_change$resample
data.frame(
  metric = c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE"),
  mean   = colMeans(resamp[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], na.rm = TRUE),
  sd     = apply(resamp[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
)

saveRDS(rf_plant_change, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_plant_change_tune.rds"))
write.csv(rf_plant_change$results, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_plant_change_tune_ranking.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Fit final model with best hyperparameters
```{r}
best_mtry     <- rf_plant_change_tune$bestTune$mtry
best_nodesize <- rf_plant_change_tune$bestTune$min.node.size

rf_plant_change <- ranger::ranger(
  total_change_pct ~ .,
  data          = plant_change_train,
  num.trees     = 500,
  mtry          = best_mtry,
  min.node.size = best_nodesize,
  splitrule     = "variance",
  importance    = "permutation",
  num.threads   = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  seed          = 123
)

rf_plant_change

# Save the model
saveRDS(rf_plant_change, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_plant_change.rds"))
```

### Evaluate on test data
```{r}
# Predict on test data
rf_plant_change_test_pred <- predict(rf_plant_change, data = plant_change_test)

# Calculate performance metrics
r2_plant_change  <- 1 - sum((rf_plant_change_test_pred$predictions - plant_change_test$total_change_pct)^2) /
                        sum((plant_change_test$total_change_pct - mean(plant_change_test$total_change_pct))^2)
mse_plant_change <- mean((rf_plant_change_test_pred$predictions - plant_change_test$total_change_pct)^2)

r2_plant_change
mse_plant_change
```

## Fit model using cv
```{r}
rf_plant_change_full_cv <- caret::train(
  total_change_pct ~ .,
  data        = plant_data,
  method      = "ranger",
  importance  = "none",
  num.trees   = 500,
  trControl   = train_control,
  tuneGrid    = expand.grid(
    mtry          = floor(ncol(plant_data) / 3),
    splitrule     = "variance",
    min.node.size = 5
  ),
  na.action   = na.omit,
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  verbose     = TRUE,
  seed = 123,
)

rf_plant_change_full_cv

resamp <- rf_plant_change_full_cv$resample
data.frame(
  metric = c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE"),
  mean   = colMeans(resamp[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], na.rm = TRUE),
  sd     = apply(resamp[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
)

#           metric        mean         sd
#RMSE         RMSE 59.24041297 6.00263121
#Rsquared Rsquared  0.06980934 0.03575042
#MAE           MAE 37.16920831 2.25025511

# Save the cv model and results
saveRDS(rf_plant_change_full_cv, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_plant_change_full_cv.rds"))
write.csv(rf_plant_change_full_cv$results, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_plant_change_full_cv_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
